name: a_calendar_earnings
prompt:
Search the web now. You are a financial fact extractor for a US-equity pre-market brief.
Brief date: Friday October 16, 2026. Topic: Earnings calendar.

Window: Thursday October 15, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Friday October 16, 2026 02:03 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. Anything published after 02:03 ET on Friday October 16, 2026 is out of scope.

FIND
Earnings from the brief date through the next 8 NYSE sessions for US stocks >= $10B plus notable mid-caps: date, BMO/AMC, EPS and revenue consensus vs year-ago, and analyst preview notes / PT changes ahead of the print (firm, rating, PT). Only events that have NOT yet reported as of the cutoff.

Run multiple searches with different phrasings and dates. Prefer primary sources and wire services
(Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, CNBC, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investopedia, company press releases, SEC
EDGAR, BLS/BEA/Census/Fed releases, FDA). For every item give the latest status as of the cutoff.

OUTPUT (markdown; no intro or conclusion). Group by ticker or topic:

## TICKER or Topic `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or Macro / Commodities / Geopolitics / Crypto / Calendar /
Pharma / Energy / Retail, or a concise sector name. Bold tickers.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.

## **TRV** [Insurance]
- **October 16, BMO:** Travelers was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$7.01**, down **13.88%** from **$8.14** a year earlier. (Nasdaq, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[4]
- **October 16, BMO:** An alternative estimate listed consensus EPS at **$7.25** and revenue at **$11.31 billion**; the available source did not provide year-ago revenue or reconcile the EPS discrepancy. (Newsquawk, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[3]

## **TFC** [Banking]
- **October 16, BMO:** Truist Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$1.17**, up **12.50%** from **$1.04** a year earlier. (Nasdaq, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[4]
- **October 16, BMO:** Another estimate listed consensus EPS at **$1.14** and revenue at **$5.35 billion**; year-ago EPS and revenue were not provided. (Newsquawk, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[3]

## **MTB** [Banking]
- **October 16, BMO:** M&T Bank was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$4.98**, up **2.26%** from **$4.87** a year earlier. (Nasdaq, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[4]
- **October 16, BMO:** Another estimate listed consensus EPS at **$4.93** and revenue at **$2.53 billion**; year-ago EPS and revenue were not provided. (Newsquawk, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[3]

## **CFG** [Banking]
- **October 16, BMO:** Citizens Financial Group was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$1.38**, up **31.43%** from **$1.05** a year earlier. (Nasdaq, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[4]
- **October 16, BMO:** Another estimate listed consensus EPS at **$1.39** and revenue at **$2.34 billion**; year-ago EPS and revenue were not provided. (Newsquawk, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[3]

## **RF** [Banking]
- **October 16, BMO:** Regions Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$0.67**; the cited source did not provide the year-ago EPS comparison or revenue consensus. (Nasdaq, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[4]
- **October 16, BMO:** Another estimate listed consensus EPS at **$0.66** and revenue at **$1.99 billion**; year-ago EPS and revenue were not provided. (Newsquawk, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[3]

## **FITB** [Banking]
- **October 19, BMO:** Fifth Third Bancorp was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus revenue was **$3.34 billion**, up **44.96%** year over year, and consensus EPS was **$0.820**, down **9.85%** year over year. (Moomoo, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[8]

## **CLF** [Steel & Metals]
- **October 19, BMO:** Cleveland-Cliffs was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus revenue was **$5.72 billion**, up **20.91%** year over year, and consensus EPS was **$0.250**, compared with a loss in the year-ago period. (Moomoo, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[10]

## **MMM** [Diversified Industrials]
- **October 20, BMO:** 3M was scheduled to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$2.39**, versus **$2.19** a year earlier, and consensus revenue was **$6.61 billion**, versus **$6.32 billion** a year earlier. (ScanX, updated Oct 15; publish time not stated)[2]
- **October 20:** JPMorgan analyst Chigusa Katoku maintained an **Overweight** rating and cut the price target to **$185** from **$205** on October 9, before the stated reporting window. (ScanX, updated Oct 15; publish time not stated)[2]

## **HAL** [Energy Services]
- **October 20, BMO:** Halliburton was scheduled to report third-quarter 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$0.59**, versus **$0.58** a year earlier, and consensus revenue was **$5.58 billion**, versus **$5.60 billion** a year earlier. (ScanX, updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[5]
- **October 20:** UBS analyst Josh Silverstein maintained a **Neutral** rating and raised the price target to **$42** from **$39** on September 14, before the stated reporting window. (ScanX, updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[5]

## **ALLY** [Consumer Finance]
- **October 20, BMO:** Ally Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$1.33**, versus **$1.15** a year earlier, and consensus revenue was **$2.29 billion**, versus **$2.17 billion** a year earlier. (ScanX, updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[6]
- **October 20:** Morgan Stanley analyst Betsy Graseck downgraded Ally from **Overweight to Equal-Weight** and cut the price target to **$43** from **$55** on October 12. (ScanX, updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[6]
- **October 20:** JPMorgan analyst Richard Shane maintained an **Overweight** rating and cut the price target to **$43** from **$48** on October 12. (ScanX, updated Oct 16; publish time not stated)[6]

## **SYF** [Consumer Finance]
- **October 20, BMO:** Synchrony Financial was scheduled to report third-quarter fiscal 2026 results before the market open; consensus EPS was **$2.40**, versus **$2.86** a year earlier, and consensus revenue was **$3.81 billion**, versus **$3.82 billion** a year earlier. (ScanX, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[9]
- **October 20:** JPMorgan analyst Richard Shane maintained a **Neutral** rating and cut the price target to **$74** from **$78** on October 12. (ScanX, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[9]
- **October 20:** TD Cowen analyst Moshe Orenbuch maintained a **Buy** rating and cut the price target to **$86** from **$90** on October 6. (ScanX, Oct 15; publish time not stated)[9]
